options.name: accounting
options.description: Advanced accounting settings

options.name: accountingStorageTRES
options.description: List of resources you wish to track on the cluster (slurm: AccountingStorageTRES)

options.name: autoDetect
options.description: Detect NVIDIA (nvml) or AMD (rsmi) or Intel (oneapi) GPUs or AWS Trainium/Inferentia devices (nrt) automatically (global option), or use the cluster manager information (bcm). GPU configuration is part of Slurm GRES.

options.name: batchStartTimeout
options.description: The maximum time (in seconds) that a batch job is permitted for launching before being considered missing and releasing the allocation (value 0 removes the parameter from slurm.conf)

options.name: cgroups
options.description: Submode containing Slurm related cgroups settings

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: configureMigs
options.description: Detect and configure MIG profiles as GPU types in Slurm

options.name: enablePrejob
options.description: Enable Bright Cluster Manager powered prejob healthchecking in the workload manager

options.name: epilog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a script to execute as user root on every node when a user's job completes

options.name: epilogSlurmctld
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a program for the slurmctld to execute upon termination of a job allocation

options.name: etc
options.description: Slurm configuration files directory

options.name: fastSchedule
options.description: Controls how a node's configuration specifications in slurm.conf are used

options.name: gresConfFileTemplate
options.description: Template for gres.conf file

options.name: gresTypes
options.description: A list of generic resources to be managed

options.name: moduleFileTemplate
options.description: Template content for system module file

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: network
options.description: Network that will be used to form FQDN node names

options.name: ociSettings
options.description: OCI container settings for Slurm

options.name: placeholders
options.description: Job queue node placeholders mode

options.name: powerSavingEnabled
options.description: Enable power saving options into slurm.conf

options.name: prefix
options.description: Slurm root installation directory

options.name: primaryServer
options.description: The WLM primary server (where the active WLM daemon will be running).

options.name: prolog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a program for the slurmd to execute whenever it is asked to run a job step from a new job allocation

options.name: prologEpilogTimeout
options.description: The interval in seconds Slurm waits for Prolog and Epilog before terminating them (value 0 removes the parameter from slurm.conf)

options.name: prologFlags
options.description: Flags to control the prolog behavior

options.name: prologSlurmctld
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a program for the slurmctld daemon to execute before granting a new job allocation

options.name: resumeProgram
options.description: Program that will be executed when a suspended node is needed by a submitted jobs

options.name: resumeTimeout
options.description: Maximum time permitted (in second) between when a node is resume request is issued and when the node is actually available for use

options.name: scheduler
options.description: Scheduler to use in combination with slurm

options.name: schedulerParameters
options.description: Parameters specific to the scheduler. The interpretation of them varies by SchedulerType

options.name: selectType
options.description: The type of resource selection algorithm to be used (slurm: SelectType)

options.name: selectTypeParameters
options.description: Parameters specific to Select Type (slurm: SelectTypeParameters)

options.name: slurmConfFileTemplate
options.description: Template for slurm.conf file

options.name: slurmctldParameters
options.description: Parameters specific to the Slurmctld

options.name: slurmdParameters
options.description: Parameters specific to the Slurmd

options.name: srunEpilog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a script to execute after completion of job step (invoked by srun).

options.name: srunProlog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a script to execute prior to launching job step (invoked by srun).

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: stateSave
options.description: Directory into which the Slurm controller saves its state

options.name: suspendProgram
options.description: Program that will be executed when a node remains idle for an extended period of time

options.name: suspendTime
options.description: Nodes which remain idle for this number of seconds will be placed into power save mode by SuspendProgram

options.name: suspendTimeout
options.description: Maximum time permitted (in second) between when a node suspend request is issued and when the node shutdown

options.name: taskEpilog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a script to execute after completion of job step (invoked by slurmstepd).

options.name: taskProlog
options.description: Fully qualified pathname of a script to execute prior to launching job step (invoked by slurmstepd).

options.name: topologySwitches
options.description: List of switches that should be used to write the topology file

options.name: tracingJobs
options.description: A list of job ids to trace in CMDaemon

options.name: version
options.description: Major Slurm version
